chapters.title: Invent a New Object
chapters.blurb: A research brief bans five established cryptanalytic lenses and asks Mythos Preview to find a genuinely new object to track through six reduced AES rounds.

chapters.title: Four Points Survive
chapters.blurb: Four finite-field points pass through key addition, inversion, and affine mixing while their projective cross-ratio remains unchanged.

chapters.title: The Honest Dead Ends
chapters.blurb: Exact early-round structure, a field-rank surprise, a false statistical signal, and disciplined negative results narrow the discovery into the Möbius Bridge.
